sources.title: Nothing’s upcoming Ear Note is a pair of earbuds with AI transcription

cards.summary: Nothing's new AI device is the Ear Note, a set of earbuds and their microphone-equipped charging case that can record and transcribe conversations, with a connected app to manage the recordings, transcriptions and AI-generated summaries, similar to Apple's new Watch feature and devices like Amazon's Bee wearable . Nothing CEO Carl Pei demonstrated the new device to Bloomberg , but said the company hasn't yet settled on a price ahead of a planned launch on December 8th.
